data.current_summary: Autosave / rename / move / archive / restore a file
data.current_description: Content writes require an optimistic-lock precondition: send `version` in the request body (recommended). The `If-Match: "<version>"` header is also accepted, but callers behind a CDN should prefer `version` — `If-Match` is a reserved HTTP conditional header (RFC 9110 §13.1.1) that an intermediary may evaluate at the edge and answer with 412 even when the write succeeds. The origin itself never returns 412. A stale precondition returns 409 with the current server copy. Content writes overwrite the working blob and bump the version; they do not create version-history rows. 0 credits.
data.summary_suggestion: Update file content, metadata, or state (autosave/rename/move/archive/restore)
data.description_suggestion: Updates file content, metadata, or state. Supports content autosave, renaming, moving between folders, archiving, and restoring. Content writes require optimistic-lock precondition via `version` field in request body (recommended over `If-Match` header for CDN compatibility). Stale preconditions return 409 with current server state. Content updates overwrite the working blob and increment version without creating version-history entries. Returns updated File object. No credits charged.
